docs.title: DocOps AI MVP
docs.text: This is the local documentation site for the DocOps AI MVP.

docs.title: What this project demonstrates
docs.text:
• API changes can be analyzed automatically
  • impacted documentation can be identified
  • AI can propose documentation updates
  • docs can be rendered through MkDocs and validated in CI

docs.title: Example API change
docs.text: The demo user API supports a status filter for listing users by state.

docs.title: Query parameters
docs.text: Name Type Required Description status string No Filters users by current status (active, inactive, pending).

docs.title: User management
docs.text: The user management experience supports filtering by status.

docs.title: Status filtering
docs.text: Use the status parameter on the users API to limit results to a specific lifecycle state.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
GET /users?status=pending

This is useful for listing accounts awaiting review.
